fr_html: M. LODER est d’avis qu’un vœu n’est pas suffisant, à moins que le Président ne veuille retirer sa proposition.
en_html: M. LODER was of the opinion that a recommendation was not sufficient, unless the President were willing to withdraw his proposition.
